references.text: Mentions the destruction of high places (במות) and idols, the same theme as in Leviticus 26:30
Describes the destruction of Baal altars and Asherah poles (חמנים), using the same wording as in the main verse
Ezekiel prophesies about the destruction of high places, Asherah poles, and idols (גלולים), with dead bodies before the images
Repeats the theme of corpses among the idols (גלולים), a direct parallel to פגריכם על פגרי גלוליכם
Prophesies that people will no longer look to the altars and Asherah poles (חמנים) made by their own hands
Describes the destruction of high places (במות) and Asherah poles (חמנים) during Asa's reforms
Josiah killed the priests at the high places and burned human bones on the altars, a similar judgment as in Leviticus 26:30
God says that His soul abhors (געל) the people's actions, using the same expression for God's loathing
